question.problem: If $[a]_{n}$ denotes the residue class containing all integers congruent to $a$ modulo $n,$ then $[16]_{7}=$
question.worked_solution:
We have $[a]_{7}=[b]_{7}$ if 

$$
a≡b\,(\text{mod}\,7).
$$

The residue class $[16]_{7}$ consists of the elements that are congruent to $17$ modulo $7.$ 

We can find an alternative representation for this residue class as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[16]_{7} & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡16\,(\text{mod}\,7)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡2\cdot 7+2\,(\text{mod}\,7)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡2\cdot 0+2\,(\text{mod}\,7)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡2\,(\text{mod}\,7)} \\  & =[2]_{7}\end{aligned}
$$
